title: mcp: the open door's initialize instructions carry the ask-data selection rule and the skills install line; /mcp/skill renders from the published skill
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「同意你的所有建议，开始立专题子卡」. The ruling record is #34659 comment 6940528935.

## Why

The open MCP server tells a connecting client one sentence, then lists 40 KB of tools. The rule for choosing between a governed metric and an object query sits inside one tool's description, which a client reads only if it already chose that tool. A client that ran `claude mcp add` and nothing else therefore has no instruction to look for a metric first.

Who acts: the server lane (`packages/mcp`, `packages/runtime`). Who reads the result: every MCP client of a self-hosted app.

## Evidence (objectstack `a0326b06`, `examples/app-crm` booted, admin API key, read 2026-11-17)

- `initialize` → `result.instructions` is 98 bytes: `DEFAULT_HTTP_INSTRUCTIONS` (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts:1771`).
- `tools/list` is 17 tools, 40,341 bytes.
- `GET /api/v1/mcp/skill` is 16,625 bytes and is served as a page only (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts:292-380`); it is not an MCP resource and not the instructions.
- Nothing the open server sends names `@objectstack/skills` or a version to install. The hosted door does (`Published skills: @objectstack/skills <version>`).
- `packages/mcp/README.md`, `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`, `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` and `skills/objectstack-query/rules/aggregation.md` do not mention `list_datasets` or `query_dataset` (0 occurrences each).

## Scope (ruled D5 = A, #34659 comment 6940528935)

- The open server's `initialize` instructions state, in a few lines: look for a governed metric first (`list_datasets` with the question's business words), one match answers through `query_dataset`, several ask back, none falls back to the object tools and says so. Only when the dataset tools are registered for the grant.
- The instructions name the published skills package and the version to install, taken from the server's own version.
- The data-loop text of `/mcp/skill` is rendered from the published ask-data skill (sibling skills card), so there is one source.
- The four documents above mention the dataset tools.
- File surface: `packages/mcp/src/**`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `packages/mcp/README.md`, `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`. The two `skills/**` mentions belong to the sibling skills card.

## Done when

- A fresh `initialize` against `examples/app-crm` returns the selection rule and the install line, and returns neither dataset sentence for a grant without `data:read`.
- A test pins that the `/mcp/skill` data-loop text equals the published skill's.
- The instructions stay small: state the byte count in the PR.

## Out of scope

- Any change to `list_datasets` matching (E2 is ruled B with a premise).
- The authoring (draft) tools: a later milestone of #34659.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Blocked by the sibling skills card for the single-source half only; the instructions half can land first.
- Dedup, open and closed: `"mcp/skill" initialize instructions selection rule` 0; `MCP initialize instructions skill in:title` 0.
